[spoiler=Expansion RP]
In the year of 1588, King James Gytman unified the kingdoms of the Eortrian peninsula under his control, either by economic promises and deals or simply by military conquests. The new kingdom, known as Gythena, was established under the house of Gytman and quickly became a major player in Northern Elseyran politics. The army was modernized and updated with modern weaponry such as muskets and more precise ammunition to support new weaponry. The new army was quickly put to work, training and solving logistical challenges brought by factors such as the climate, cost of war and communications between armies and divisions.

The armed forces were given 14 years of training before the Gythenan government, under the helm of the great James Gytman, launched a double surprise invasion of Ivonia and Bastarte. The two kingdoms to the south were luckily informed of building northern forces, so forts and other military installations were constructed unbeknownst to the Gythenan army. The initial offensive, beginning at the Battle of Loch Hosstiver, was surprisingly hard for Gythena as Bastarte forces had a strong defensive line along the lake.

After about a month passed, the Hosttiver lines finally broke and Gythena continued their delayed offensive. The Ivonian front was very successful, and after 3 months of fighting in the capital of Ivon, the Ivonians surrendered and were coerced to join up with the Gythenan forces. Bastarte lines were now crumbling down, so negotiations were held in 1602 to bring peace to the kingdoms again. In this, the kingdoms of Ivonia and Bastarte were folded into Gythena, which was a massive boost to Gythenan power thanks to their fertile lands and copper deposits.

The two kingdoms actually flourished under these conditions, as thanks to their more temperate climate and solid naval infrastructure, they were able to grow quickly compared to the other more northern provinces. They played a key role in keeping Gythena stable and maintaining its economic and political position in Northern Elseyr.

The city of Ivon, Ivonias capital city, became a major trading hub and a hotspot for culture, being a major factor in keeping Ivonias regional culture and its famously humorous accent. Bastarte was not connected to the sea as well, however it was much more mountainous and rocky than Ivonia, meaning it was more difficult to influence or control the infrastructure of the state, which allowed it to also keep its native regional culture alive.

Today the two regions play an instrumental role in Gythena as the agricultural heart of the nation, growing much of the nations food and reducing Gythenan dependency on food imports. The two provinces also ensure there is both a secure southern border and a stable hold on the Coleraine Mountains.
[/spoiler]

[quote=lamandica;60355667][b]HORGINGTONIA (Lamandican Petoleum Colony? Why?)[/b]

In terms of oil, we have no oil.

Lamandica's two largest oil companies, RELCO and Cieliox, are on the verge of being shut down. Throughout Lamandica's history, the nation has had very few oil resources, and the ones that were present have since dried up. Prices for a liter of gas in Lamandica have hit an all-time high of [u]eleven[/u] Pelops. With growing demand for very limited gas resources, Prime Minister Calieno-Ruiz has called an emergency meeting and announced a solution: Lamandica's first-ever colony.

This colony, which will be called Horgingtonia (or Lamandican Petroleum Colony), will be established just to the north of [nation]Hatorre[/nation] in Southwestern Vespuria. Its capital will be Puerto Encarnacion, with the rest of the province being mainly refineries and onshore drilling facilities. This area has been chosen due to its plentiful oil resources, as well as being the closest available land with oil to Lamandica. This colony is expected to be quite wealthy and full of prospecting contractors, claims Calieno-Ruiz. This will be the first time under the governance of Calieno-Ruiz that Lamandica will seek to expand.[/quote]
